counterfactual_missing_items: No epithelial components, mitoses, or atypical cell-shape features
decisive_items: cystoid mass with a stalk attached to the nasal pars plana
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells
response.rationale: R3 uniquely integrates raw ciliary-body anatomy, stalked cystoid imaging, myxoid spindle/stellate histology, and S100 positivity. R2 has only neural IHC markers without anatomic localization. R1 lacks ciliary-body localization and GFAP support. C1 is a redundant anatomy-only completion of R3.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R3; raw spans only restate ciliary body anatomy and add no independent histology or IHC evidence.
Lacks ciliary-body/anatomy support; GFAP patchy positivity is unexplained, and S100 plus myxoid spindle cells are nonspecific for neurofibroma.
